name: Sugar Cane
why: Reproductions of postwar American workwear and denim, woven in Japan on vintage shuttle looms, with sugar-cane fiber blended into the cotton.
origin: A label of Toyo Enterprise, the Japanese company founded in 1965 that also makes Buzz Rickson's and Sun Surf.

onething.n: the reproduction that made the house; own-site search, not opened from this environment

notes.murica: American workwear reproduced from Japan — observed with more care than the originals received, and made on looms the Americans discarded. Americana at one remove, which is why it sits at four rather than five.
